cards.title: Stock-Flow Record
cards.description: Resource stock, extraction, regeneration, loss, units, measurement status, and system boundary.

cards.title: Regeneration Record
cards.description: Constant, proportional, logistic, threshold-dependent, seasonal, or environment-dependent renewal.

cards.title: Extraction Record
cards.description: Harvest, pumping, mining, demand, leakage, waste, efficiency, substitution, and governance rules.

cards.title: Threshold Record
cards.description: Critical stock levels, slow recovery, collapse risk, and irreversibility assumptions.

cards.title: Yield Record
cards.description: Sustainable yield, maximum sustainable yield, precautionary harvest, and uncertainty.

cards.title: Claim Boundary
cards.description: Teaching, monitoring, scenario comparison, management, policy analysis, or decision support.
